gbm_population_evidence.quote: Epitentorial glioblastoma confirmed by pathology; Diagnosis of recurrence through clinical imaging evidence.

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and effectiveness in the treatment of recurrent glioblastoma with Cadonilimab combined with fractionated radiotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Treatment of Recurrent Glioblastoma With Fractionated Radiotherapy Combined With Cadonilimab

role_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and effectiveness in the treatment of recurrent glioblastoma with Cadonilimab combined with fractionated radiotherapy.

arms: Patients will receive the treatment of fractionated radiotherapy and Cadonilimab

coder_notes: Single-arm re-irradiation plus cadonilimab (also spelled 'Cardunizumab' in the record). Cadonilimab is the only drug; regimen combination because radiotherapy is in the experimental arm. No biomarkers, PK or PD planned.
